page_id.description: Cached page identifier. Accepts a page ID issued to this client. Unknown or expired IDs return page_unavailable.

pattern.description: Literal text to find. Accepts 1–1024 Unicode characters. No regular expressions are evaluated.

case_sensitive.description: Case matching mode. Accepts false or true, default false. false uses Unicode case-insensitive matching, true requires the exact case.

start_line.description: First line to search. Accepts 1–10000, default 1. Use next_start_line to continue a truncated result.

max_matches.description: Maximum matching lines. Accepts 1–100, default 20. More matching lines are reported through truncated.
